from datetime import time
expected = time(22, 21, 36, tzinfo=t530)
actual = parse.parse('a {:tt} b', 'a 10:21:36 PM -530 b').fixed[0]

print('Expected:', expected)
print('Actual:', actual)
print('Equal?', expected == actual)
